		nationalist_right_wing_populists_are_in_power = yes
	}
	OR = {
		COLDWAR_TUR_1970_identity_mhp = yes
		COLDWAR_TUR_1970_identity_mp = yes
		COLDWAR_TUR_1970_identity_mcp = yes
		COLDWAR_TUR_1970_identity_mhp_restored = yes
	}
	hidden_trigger = {
		original_tag = TUR
		IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
		OR = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_done_nine_lights
		}
	}
}
